headline: Discussed possible events at Holman Stadium, including movie nights, a winter rink, and a carnival, with no votes recorded.
summary: Members talked about adding events such as movie nights, a Jackie Robinson anniversary event, and a parking lot carnival, and about possible fee changes for groups that reserve the stadium. No motions or votes were recorded, and the group plans to meet again in February 2027.

Holman Stadium Activation Committee Minutes – October 14, 2026 
 
 
Holman Stadium Activation Committee 
Public Meeting MINUTES 
October 14 2026, 3:00 pm 
Mayor's Suite at Holman Stadium 
  
 
Attendees: 
Commissioner Paul Shea - Chairman 
Grant Morris 
Assistant Director Matt Leblanc 
Superintendent Bryan Conant  
Superintendent Eric Menard 
Sandy Belknap 
Director Liz Hannum  
Alyssa O’Mara  
Cam Cook – Silver Knights  
Alderman Amber Morgan - Absent 
Commissioner June Lemen - Absent 
Commissioner Manny Espitia – Absent  
 
 
Call to Order: 3:00 pm  
 
Public Comment – No public comment 
 
Current Business 
 
• Group discussed additional activities/events to add at Holman Stadium 
o Commissioner Shea expressed interest in leading with the idea of movie nights. 
• Superintendent Conant mentioned offering more activities in the Pavillion section for the 4th of 
July event 
• Grant Morris asked about the fee structure for groups reserving Holman. Superintendent Conant 
said that there will be discussion over the winter on updating those rates.  
o Someone else in the group suggested having different rates for non-profit versus for-
profit organizations 
• In discussion of major concerts, the question was brought up about whether there was an 
ordinance regarding Loud Music at Holman, and what specifically is listed in said ordinance. 
o With major concert, there was conversation about how big of a workload or group 
commitment there would need to be and how far in advance that process starts. Group 
said it would be better to start with “smaller” ideas first. 
• The group discussed having a calendar on the City Website to promote events at Holman 
Stadium.  
o Cam Cook mentioned that events could also be listed on the Silver Knights website.
Holman Stadium Activation Committee Minutes – October 14, 2026 
o Also use the electric sign on Amherst St. 
• Other ideas that the group discussed was something around Jackie Robinson (this upcoming 
season is an anniversary of him joining the MLB), doing a Carnival in the Holman Stadium 
parking lot, the idea of a rink inside Holman during the winter, and a Movie Series or german 
Christmas Fair like in the Town of Amherst..  
• There is a women’s baseball team based out of Boston, discussion on having them play a game at 
Holman with a movie on the field afterwards. 
• Commissioner Shea and Superintendent Conant spoke on meeting to schedule “impact amounts” 
during the year to determine what type of events could happen during different times of the year. 
• Plan to meet again in February 2027 
 
Adjournment
